text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
There's been so much to think about<n>lately when it
comes to training. I feel<n>like my head is going to
explode.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Oh dear, you look exhausted!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
There, there, Trainer. I know you've<n>been working
hard.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: After all this effort, I think you<n>deserve a treat.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Nope, there's no way around<n>it—you're getting that
treat.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Even if you were only working hard<n>for your own
sake, the fruits of your<n>labor still trickle down to me.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
It only makes sense for me to pay<n>you back
somehow.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Let me know if there's anything you<n>want, okay?
Perhaps a tasty meal? Or<n>a shoulder massage?
choice_data_list: Maybe something to clear my head...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Your head...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
In that case, I've got just the thing!<n>Sit tight. I just
need to make a call.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
After making a phone call, Super<n>Creek leads me
away.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Heya! Over here, Creek!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Maruzen! Sorry to keep you waiting!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Hehe, thanks for calling! Shall we get<n>to it?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
We're going to the most wonderful<n>place. Right,
Maruzen? ♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Exactamundo. You're gonna have the<n>best time
ever! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: A bit later...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: It's time for the real deal! Hold on<n>tight, you two!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oh my gosh! You're really drifting<n>around these
corners. Isn't this<n>exciting, Trainer? ♪

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
We're at a racing circuit. The squeal<n>of tires fills my
ears as the wind pulls<n>back the skin on my face.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I can barely keep my eyes open as<n>Maruzensky
careens around the<n>track in her beloved car. My
mind<n>goes completely blank.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Ahh, that felt incredible! I haven't had<n>such a
radical time in so long!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
How'd you like that speed? Bet your<n>head's clear
now, huh?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Maruzen's given me a ride in her car<n>before.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
It felt so amazing that I figured you'd<n>like it too,
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: What did you think?
choice_data_list: You've got a stronger stomach than I have.
You've got a stronger stomach than I have.

Well, her driving is nothing to sneeze at, I'll tell you
that...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: What did you think?
choice_data_list: You've got a stronger stomach than I have.
You've got a stronger stomach than I have.

Well, her driving is nothing to sneeze at, I'll tell you
that...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, did you feel it in your guts?<n>You're all
psyched up now, huh?! ♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
That's wonderful! It makes<n>organizing this all
worthwhile.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Thank you for your help, Maruzen.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
It's all good! I could do this every<n>day. In fact,
wanna go for another<n>spin?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Goodness! Really?!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! Well, if you're offering, then<n>I'll happily
accept. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Although I politely decline, they're<n>feeling too
"psyched up" to actually<n>hear me.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Aww, you'll make me blush with<n>compliments like
that! Cut it out<n>already! But seriously, thanks!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Isn't that nice, Maruzen? Thank you<n>so much!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Don't mention it. In fact, I'm always<n>down for
doing stuff like this!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
It's been way too long since I last put<n>the pedal to
the metal! Wowzers, it<n>felt amazing! ♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
You were seriously impressive. How<n>on earth did
you learn to drive like<n>that?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, I suppose I just have a knack<n>for it.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Exhausted beyond belief, I listen to<n>Maruzensky
and Super Creek chat<n>away.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
At least, it looks like Super Creek has<n>learned
something from<n>Maruzensky's fierce driving.
